name: Roflumilast
summary: Roflumilast, sold under the brand name Daxas among others, is a medication used for the treatment of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, plaque psoriasis, seborrheic dermatitis, and atopic dermatitis. It acts as a selective, long-acting inhibitor of the enzyme phosphodiesterase-4 (PDE-4). It has anti-inflammatory effects.

pharmacology.text: It acts as a selective, long-acting inhibitor of the enzyme phosphodiesterase-4 (PDE-4).

uses.text: Roflumilast, sold under the brand name Daxas among others, is a medication used for the treatment of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, plaque psoriasis, seborrheic dermatitis, and atopic dermatitis. It was approved for medical use in the European Union in 2010, in the United States in 2011, and in Canada in 2017. It is available as a generic medication.

sideEffects.text: Common (1–10% incidence) adverse effects include diarrhea, weight loss, nausea, headache, insomnia, decreased appetite, abdominal pain, rhinitis, sinusitis, urinary tract infection, and depression.

fact.en: Roflumilast was developed for chronic lung disease, but because it raises cyclic AMP in brain cells it has also been studied for memory, and it is now used as a cream for psoriasis too.
fact.zh: Roflumilast 原本是為慢性肺病開發的，但因為它會提高腦細胞中的環腺苷單磷酸，也被研究用於記憶，現在還有治療乾癬的乳膏劑型。
fact.zhHans: Roflumilast 原本是为慢性肺病开发的，但因为它会提高脑细胞中的环腺苷单磷酸，也被研究用于记忆，现在还有治疗干癣的乳膏剂型。
